notes.title: Billie’s Wheelie Release Date Announced! 🐹💨
notes.notes:
The wheel is spinning, and the wait is almost over! 🐹💨
I'm excited to announce that Billie’s Wheelie officially launches this October 24, 2025 on Steam! To kick things off, we’ve dropped the very first trailer—showcasing hamster-fueled chaos, wild tracks, and non-stop racing fun.

🎮 1–8 players, online and local racing
🐹 Hamster energy at full speed
🔥 Fast-paced challenges and hilarious chaos

Add Billie’s Wheelie to your Wishlist and be ready when the hamsters hit the track this October!
